<subject>Electronic Transactions Agreement - revised</subject>
<body>
As you know, the ETA must cover Trade one-to-many with Maple & Crown Telecom and Match one-to-many with Maple & Crown Telecom. We also require a separate Trade GTC one-to-many with Maple & Crown Telecom and a separate Match GTC one-to-many with Maple & Crown Telecom. Additionally, a single Password application addressing both Match and Trade, each one-to-many, is needed.

Please send me the drafts as soon as they are ready—I’d like to review them!

Thank you.

MW

cc:
Subject: Electronic Transactions Agreement - revised

Attached is a revised version of the ETA removing the distinction between transactions on Match and transactions on Trade. If Maple & Crown Telecom is the only party authorized to post products on Match, the special provisions we drafted previously for the "many-to-many" matching platform are unnecessary. However, we will need to create a separate set of GTCs for transactions that Maple & Crown Telecom executes on Match, since the products traded there may not align with our standard GTC framework.
